text: Managing a team is not always easy, but good communication makes a big difference. A strong leader shares information clearly and listens to team members. Delegation is also important; when you trust people with tasks, they feel valued and grow in confidence. Regular feedback helps everyone improve and know what they are doing well. Motivation comes from recognising good work and supporting people when they struggle. Finally, when conflicts happen, a good manager listens to both sides and helps the team find a fair solution. By combining these skills, a leader can build a positive and successful team.
